body:
Some more changes:
- Updated to align with godotengine/godot/pull/123094, so now the selected point controls all reside under `selected_hb` which gets hidden/shown, while `edit_hb` containing the spacer, `selected_hb` and the erase button is always visible.
- `set_fit_to_longest_item` now disabled for Play Mode in StateMachine to match changes made in godotengine/godot/pull/121553. The ones in BlendSpaces could have been declared at creation, and now do so.
- Replaced "points" and "triangles" in tooltips withwith "point" and "triangle," until multi-select is implemented for BlendSpaces.
- There were 3 lines per BlendSpace editor added in godotengine/godot/pull/123094 which could have just used BoxContainer's `add_spacer()`, and have been swapped out.
